metaDescription: Shop custom gold school spirit items at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for pep rallies, fundraisers, and events. Order bulk today!
introHtml: Gold is a color that stands for excellence and achievement, making it a natural fit for school spirit gear. Whether you are outfitting a championship team or creating giveaways for a homecoming event, gold items help your school colors pop. From custom gold lanyards and pom-poms to gold-printed T-shirts and hats, these pieces work well for pep rallies, fundraisers, and alumni gatherings. Screen printing or embroidery on gold backgrounds can create a bold, unified look for your student body or fan base.
